value.rationale: The object is the entire canonical odd polynomial subspace through Gaussian degree three, not an arbitrary coefficient slice. Its exact L6 geometry has two nontrivial, isolated projective extremizers: a negative third-chaos mixture suppresses the sixth moment from 15 to about 4.61687, and a positive mixture increases it beyond the pure cubic 53745 to about 57613.8761. Determining both sharp norm endpoints and equality rigidity resolves a natural complete two-dimensional Hermite-space invariant not obtained by simply applying classical hypercontractivity.
